column3: (Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) The JavaScript keeps its explanatory comments on purpose (words such as "admin" or "user" in prose); they hold no secret, hostname or credential. Gitleaks checks for real secrets.

(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) The HTML forms are never processed by the server: a POST to a page answers 405. JavaScript sends the data as JSON to /api/, where CSRF is stopped by the Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site checks, JSON-only bodies and SameSite cookies (server/http.mjs, assertSameOrigin; tested in test/accounts.test.mjs).
